profile.temperament.01: Restless. Does not hold one spot.
profile.temperament.04: Curious about new objects in the room.
profile.temperament.05: Calm. Reacts to disturbance, not to presence.
profile.temperament.06: Withdrawn when the room is crowded.
profile.temperament.08: Quiet. Rarely raises the reading by itself.
profile.temperament.09: Responds to change in the room, not to people.
profile.temperament.10: Slow to settle after a disturbance.
profile.temperament.11: Indifferent to light. Stronger in shade.
profile.temperament.12: Guarded. Gives little away on the first sweep.
profile.temperament.13: Deliberate. Moves only when the room is still.
profile.temperament.14: Watchful. Tracks changes near the door.
profile.temperament.15: Unhurried. Takes its time to answer the sensor.
profile.temperament.17: Steady. Holds the same reading for long stretches.
profile.temperament.19: Stubborn. Returns to the same spot after a disturbance.
profile.temperament.20: Reclusive. Avoids the busiest part of the house.
profile.temperament.21: Inquisitive. Lingers near anything recently moved.
profile.temperament.22: Subdued. Answers weakly, then more strongly.
profile.attachment.00: Attached to an object older than the current occupants.
profile.attachment.01: Drawn to the lowest room in the building.
profile.attachment.02: Linked to a doorway or a stairwell.
profile.attachment.04: Tied to a spot where the floor changes level.
profile.attachment.06: Anchored to a window that is rarely opened.
profile.attachment.07: Keeps to the part of the building with the least traffic.
profile.attachment.08: Associated with a fixed piece of furniture.
profile.attachment.09: Holds close to a place that has not been altered.
profile.attachment.10: Drawn to the point where two rooms meet.
profile.attachment.11: Follows the line of an old route through the building.
profile.attachment.12: Linked to a room that has changed use over the years.
profile.attachment.13: Stays near a threshold that is crossed often.
profile.attachment.14: Tied to the oldest staircase in the building.
profile.attachment.15: Associated with a cupboard or recess that is seldom opened.
profile.attachment.16: Drawn to the room furthest from the entrance.
profile.attachment.17: Holds close to a hearth or the place where one used to be.
profile.attachment.18: Attached to a spot beneath the roofline.
profile.attachment.19: Follows the path between two doors.
profile.attachment.20: Linked to a mirror, a frame or a similar fixed surface.
profile.attachment.21: Stays near the original floor level.
profile.attachment.22: Tied to a corridor that carries sound.
profile.attachment.23: Drawn to the point where the building was extended.
profile.behaviour.00: Most active when the house is quiet.
profile.behaviour.01: Disturbs readings for under a minute, then stops.
profile.behaviour.03: Reading drops when the room is entered, then recovers.
profile.behaviour.04: Appears briefly, then fades below threshold.
profile.behaviour.05: Moves along walls, not across the room.
profile.behaviour.06: Shows as a cold spot before any other signal.
profile.behaviour.07: Active in short bursts with long gaps.
profile.behaviour.08: Tends to repeat the same reading on the next sweep.
profile.behaviour.09: Strongest at the edge of the sensor range.
profile.behaviour.10: Leaves a faint residue on the field reading.
profile.behaviour.11: Reacts to a change in air movement.
profile.behaviour.12: Reading climbs slowly, then falls away at once.
profile.behaviour.13: Strongest a few steps from the sensor.
profile.behaviour.14: Disturbs the signal in a narrow band, then releases it.
profile.behaviour.15: Fades when the sensor is held still.
profile.behaviour.16: Returns to the same corner on each sweep.
profile.behaviour.17: Raises the reading when the lights are low.
profile.behaviour.18: Shows first as a drop in the field reading.
profile.behaviour.19: Active for a few minutes, then silent for much longer.
profile.behaviour.20: Tends to follow the sensor along the wall.
profile.behaviour.21: Leaves a thin trace near doorways.
profile.behaviour.22: Reading wavers at the edge of the frame.
profile.behaviour.23: Stronger on the second sweep than the first.
profile.timing.03: Activity tracks the cold part of the night.
profile.timing.06: Rises at dusk. Falls before dawn.
profile.timing.07: Peaks in the hour after the house goes still.
profile.timing.10: Activity rises in the hour before dawn.
profile.timing.17: Rises in the last light of the day.
profile.timing.18: Stronger when the house has been empty for a while.
profile.timing.19: Activity is steady through the small hours.
profile.timing.21: Strongest in the hour after sunset.
profile.timing.22: Activity dips when the heating comes on.
profile.timing.23: Rises when the house settles for the night.
